applications.name: Document Management System
applications.summary: One place for every document — policies, contracts, invoices, correspondence, project and technical files — with versioning, approval, retention, full-text search and an AI assistant.
applications.description: A document management system for the whole organisation. Company Documents holds policies and procedures, contracts and agreements, invoices and financial records, correspondence, project and technical documents; Confidential Records holds employee records, legal and regulatory documents and board records behind deny-by-absence access. Each of the ten document types carries its own metadata and an automatic document number (CON-0001, FIN-0001, …), and documents file themselves by business area and year. Versions are insert-only with check-in/check-out, releases go through review and approval, and every type follows its own retention period and review cycle, with legal hold for confidential records. Find anything by metadata or full text, or ask the AI assistant, which answers from document content with citations and from the register itself. Dashboards show what is on file, how it is growing, contracts ending in the next 90 days and records due for disposal.
features: Ten document types with their own metadata: policies, contracts, invoices, correspondence, project, technical and general documents, plus employee, legal and board records
Automatic document numbers and filing by business area and year
Insert-only version history, check-in/check-out, and approval before publication
Per-type retention and review schedules, with legal hold for confidential records
Metadata and full-text search, and an AI assistant that answers from document content with citations
Deny-by-absence Confidential Records with encrypted national IDs and redacted indexing
Four dashboards: overview, governance, acknowledgement and assistant analytics, including contracts ending in 90 days and records due for disposal

applications.name: Support360 — Support Ticketing
applications.summary: An internal support desk: employees raise tickets, agents work them through a controlled status flow, and every change lands in an audit log.
applications.description: A support ticketing platform for the whole organisation. Employees raise tickets with a category, priority and attachments; the ticket number and raiser are filled in automatically. Tickets move strictly forward — Open, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved, Closed — with each transition validated, resolution notes required before resolving, and only the raiser able to confirm-close or reopen. Agents work a queue of unassigned tickets and their own, assignment and reassignment run from a dedicated screen, and admins maintain the category, priority and agent masters and can manage every ticket. Every creation, assignment, status change, comment, attachment and edit writes an old-value/new-value entry to the ticket's activity log. Employee, Agent and Admin dashboards show open, unassigned and resolved-this-period counts, tickets by status and priority, and the status trend.
features: Raise tickets with category, priority and attachments; ticket number and raiser filled in automatically
Forward-only status flow Open → Assigned → In Progress → Resolved → Closed, validated at every step
Employees see only their own tickets and can confirm-close or reopen a resolved ticket
Agent ticket queue with start-progress, comments, attachments and resolve; separate assignment screen
Category, priority and agent masters with activate/deactivate and in-use delete protection
Activity log of every change with old value, new value and who made it
Employee, Agent and Admin dashboards with counts, breakdowns and status trends
